description: Full-text search the stella legislation corpus, returning ranked results with strict or relaxed match metadata, a highlighted snippet and each document's ELI, title, country, language, type, status, and effective date. Filter by jurisdiction, document type, status, source, language, and effective-date range; paginate with limit and cursor. Admitted jurisdiction codes (uppercase): CZE. Omit jurisdiction to search all admitted jurisdictions. Only admitted jurisdictions and sources cleared for redistribution are searched. Read a hit in full with legislation.read; use legislation.boe.search to query the Spanish BOE service directly instead.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page

jurisdiction.description: Admitted jurisdiction codes (uppercase): CZE. Omit jurisdiction to search all admitted jurisdictions.
